---
title: "Process Full Data"
output: html_document
---

```{r full_process, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(icecream)
library(sf)
library(progressr)  # Optional: for progress bars
library(reticulate)
handlers(global = TRUE)

# Plot display config for notebooks
options(jupyter.plot_mimetypes = c("text/html", "image/svg+xml", "image/png", "image/jpeg"))

# Read data
all_counts <- fread("amnesty-data/counts.csv")
all_intersections <- fread("amnesty-data/intersections.csv")
all_cameras <- fread("amnesty-data/cameras.csv")

# Check uniqueness of PanoramaId
ic(dim(all_intersections)[1])
ic(dim(unique(all_intersections))[1])
ic(length(unique(all_intersections$PanoramaId)))
ic(length(unique(all_intersections[, .(PanoramaId, Borough)])))
ic(length(unique(all_intersections[, .(PanoramaId, Borough)])) - length(unique(all_intersections$PanoramaId)))

# PanoramaId and ImageDate are uniquely linked
pano_date <- unique(all_intersections[, .(PanoramaId, ImageDate)])
ic(dim(pano_date)[1])

# Merge counts with PanoramaId
inter_to_pano <- all_intersections[, .(IntersectionId, PanoramaId)]
merged <- merge(all_counts, inter_to_pano, by = "IntersectionId", all.x = TRUE)
ic(dim(all_counts))
ic(dim(merged))
stopifnot(dim(all_counts)[1] == dim(merged)[1])

# Drop unused columns
merged <- merged[, !c("SubmissionId", "DecoderId", "DecoderGenericId", "IntersectionId", "StartTime", "EndTime"), with = FALSE]
setkey(merged, PanoramaId)

# Keep only PanoramaIds with >= 3 decoders
pano_grouped <- merged[, .N, by = PanoramaId]
kept_pano <- pano_grouped[N >= 3, PanoramaId]
n_less_than_3 <- sum(pano_grouped$N < 3)
ic(n_less_than_3)
x <- merged[PanoramaId %in% kept_pano]
ic(length(unique(merged$PanoramaId)))
ic(length(unique(x$PanoramaId)))
stopifnot(length(unique(x$PanoramaId)) == length(unique(merged$PanoramaId)) - n_less_than_3)

# Keep top 3 decoders per PanoramaId
kept_3 <- x[, head(.SD, 3), by = PanoramaId]

# Calculate median and n_unique for each variable
stats <- kept_3[, lapply(.SD, function(col) list(median = median(col), nunique = length(unique(col)))), by = PanoramaId]
stopifnot(all(stats$median %% 1 == 0))
stats <- stats[, lapply(.SD, as.integer), by = PanoramaId]

# Label agreement level
description_nunique <- c("IMPOSSIBLE", "Unanimous", "2 vs 1", "All disagree")
stats$agreement <- sapply(stats$nunique, function(n) description_nunique[n + 1])
stats$nunique <- NULL

# Reshape wide
stats_wide <- dcast(stats, PanoramaId ~ variable, value.var = c("median", "agreement"))

# Load panoramas and clean
google_panoramas <- fread("amnesty-data/panorama_url.csv")
google_panoramas <- google_panoramas[, !c("Lat", "Long"), with = FALSE]
setnames(google_panoramas, c("GoogleLat", "GoogleLong"), c("Lat", "Long"))
google_panoramas <- unique(google_panoramas)

# Load borough shapefile
boroughs <- st_read("amnesty-data/nyc_borough_boundary_water_query.json", quiet = TRUE)
boroughs <- boroughs[, c("BoroName", "geometry")]

# Cross product for borough overlap
geo_panos <- st_as_sf(google_panoramas, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326)
pano_cross_borough <- merge(geo_panos, boroughs, by = NULL)
pano_cross_borough$within <- mapply(function(b, p) st_contains(b, p, sparse = FALSE), pano_cross_borough$geometry.y, pano_cross_borough$geometry.x)

# Identify problematic panoramas
n_borough_per_pano <- pano_cross_borough[, .(n_borough = sum(within)), by = PanoramaId]
panos_without_borough <- n_borough_per_pano[n_borough_per_pano$n_borough != 1]
panos_without_borough$BoroName <- "Unknown"
panos_without_borough$n_borough <- NULL

# Keep only panoramas inside one borough
panos_with_boroughs <- pano_cross_borough[pano_cross_borough$within == TRUE, ]
panos_with_boroughs$within <- NULL
panos_with_boroughs$geometry.y <- NULL

# Recombine panoramas with and without boroughs
ic(nrow(panos_with_boroughs))
ic(nrow(google_panoramas))
stopifnot(nrow(google_panoramas) == nrow(panos_with_boroughs) + nrow(panos_without_borough))
panos_boroughed <- rbind(panos_with_boroughs, panos_without_borough)

# Add Google Street View URL and merge image dates
panos_boroughed$URL <- paste0("https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=", panos_boroughed$PanoramaId)
panos_url_date <- merge(panos_boroughed, pano_date, by = "PanoramaId", all.x = TRUE)

# Optional check for unique PanoramaIds
stopifnot(nrow(panos_url_date) == length(unique(panos_url_date$PanoramaId)))

# Final data merge
final_full_data <- merge(stats_wide, panos_url_date, by = "PanoramaId", all.x = TRUE)

# Save final CSV
fwrite(final_full_data, "amnesty-data/counts_per_intersections.csv")
